data.one_liner: Opens specific iOS and Android system settings screens from Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API to navigate directly to various device settings pages on both platforms. Supports a wide range of settings like Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, notifications, and more.
use_when: You need to let users quickly access a particular system setting from your app
You want a single plugin that covers both iOS and Android settings screens
avoid_when: You only need a single generic settings shortcut (e.g., just opening the app settings)
You require deep integration with platform‑specific APIs beyond opening settings
strengths: Supports both CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager
weaknesses: Limited to opening settings – no other device functionality
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml; on iOS ensure CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager is configured (deployment target 12.0). No extra permissions required.

alternatives.name: app_settings
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar functionality with a smaller API surface and fewer known iOS issues

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Can open generic URLs, including settings URLs, but lacks the comprehensive shortcut list
